ORDINANCE Jul Sur
4 16 262 5
BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:
SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is
hereby amended by changing all the current RS-3 Residential Single-Unit (Detached House)

District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 7-J in the area bounded by:

A line 28.6 feet north of and parallel to West Schubert Avenue; the public alley next east
of and parallel to North Lawndale Avenue; West Schubert Avenue; and North Lawndale
Avenue

to those of a B2-1.5, Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.

SECTION 2. This Ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due
publication.

Address: 3654 West Schubert Avenue
